sentences.text: Why does France vote twice for its President?
First, to run, you need signatures from 500 elected officials, like mayors.
In round one, win over half the votes, and you win outright.
If no one does, the top two face a run-off, two weeks later.
Macron got about 28%, Le Pen 23, and Mélenchon just missed out with 22.
In the run-off, Macron won with almost 59%.
The winner serves five years, and no more than two terms in a row.
So, should your country vote twice?
